summary: Verified Credit-Notes-Available reminder popup in Record Delivery flow (DeliveriesTab.jsx) for distributor Main → Toopa Ice-creamery. Popup gating, testids, checkbox toggle → total line + apply-btn enable, Proceed-Without and Apply-Selected buttons all work correctly. Regression case (account with no credit notes) also passes — no reminder shown, submit proceeds directly. Actual delivery creation is blocked by a pre-existing backend config issue (margin matrix missing for city 'Hyderabad') unrelated to this feature — it prevented producing a persisted delivery for either Path A or Path B, but the reminder-popup behavior itself is fully validated.

minor.issue: Returns 400 'Margin matrix not configured for city Hyderabad. Please configure margins for: Nyla – 600 ml / Silver' for account Toopa Ice-creamery + SKU Nyla-600ml-Silver. Same 400 for Citadel account. This blocks completing an end-to-end delivery creation in the test environment, but is pre-existing config/seed data — not caused by the credit-reminder feature.
